fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-08-15, the complainant reported that a shop near Roja Park Main Street was occupied without a valid agreement and the occupant refused to leave. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-08-14 at about 10:35. The online submission was made by Sathish Palanisamy (9000000238). Elango Prakash (mobile 9000000351) was named as a possible person of interest. A witness, Tamilarasan Velan, reachable on 9000000281, was mentioned in the complaint.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, morning, main street, mobile number, digital document, documents, suspect
